text:
Maya Chen: Hey design ops — need a compact 'mini benchpack' for the launch this Wed. Goal: a small asset set we can push across social, webinar slide, and sales one-pager. Low-touch, on-brand, and easy to localize.

Maya Chen: Priority list (in order): 1) 3 social square tiles (hero stat + 1-sentence context), 2) webinar hero/email header (1200x628), 3) 1-sheet PDF one-pager (single page, print-friendly), 4) editable slide template (16:9 Master), 5) tiny diagram (inference economics sparkline + callouts).

Maya Chen: Quick constraints: stay within brand color palette (use brand-2 for hero gradients), typography: Redwood Sans Head / Redwood UI body, include small Redwood logo lockup and 'Hosted · Dedicated · Private' line.

Maya Chen: File deliverables: PNGs + layered Figma file + PDF for one-pager. Also need a naming convention and a brief copy pack (1-liners for each tile). Can design team do first pass by EOD tomorrow? @Tess Rivera

Tess Rivera: On it — can do first pass. Will mock the 3 tile layouts + hero and one-pager. 

Tess Rivera: Couple q's: 1) copy tone: technical or customer-facing? 2) Do we have approved benchmark stats to surface, or should we use the running numbers from the research doc?

Maya Chen: Customer-facing but nerd-friendly — keep 1 stat per tile (simple). Use the research doc #benchmarks v2 numbers (link in drive) — verified by Product. Also include a small footnote: "tests on standard configs; results may vary."

Jon Park: I'll take the tiny diagram (sparkline + 3 callouts). Want vector SVG and a PNG export. For the sparkline, should it be absolute token cost or normalized cost index?

Maya Chen: Normalize to the 'cost per 1k tokens' index and annotate the percent delta vs baseline. Keep the axis labels minimal.

Liam O'Connor: Copy pack coming. Drafts for tiles: 
- Tile A: "Redwood: predictable LLM inference at 1/3 the cost"
- Tile B: "Serve anywhere — hosted, dedicated, private"
- Tile C: "Latencies under 50ms for common prompts"

Liam O'Connor: Also drafting two webinar subject lines and 3 email header variations, will drop into the thread when done.

Kate Alvarez: For inbound routing — once assets are live, can we add a UTM scheme and a simple form flow so leads from webinar assets get tagged as 'bench-launch-Q1'? Sales ops wants a dedicated nurture with a 'request a demo' CTA.

Maya Chen: Yes — tagging plan: utm_campaign=bench-mini-launch&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic. Sales ops to own nurture. @Kate Alvarez please confirm the form and demo CTA text so design can place the button.

Kate Alvarez: Confirmed. CTA copy: "Request a cost review". Form fields: Name, Email, Company, Primary use case (select). I'll share the behavioral spec in #growth after this.

Tess Rivera: Noted. Deliverables timeline: first comps tomorrow EOD, iterate Wed morning, final exports Wed afternoon. Will include a simple Figma component library for easy localization (text tokens + color styles).

Jon Park: Pushed initial svg sketch to figma board -> link. Small note: will need the exact benchmark numbers pasted into the figma frame so the sparkline labels match.

Maya Chen: I'll paste numbers in next 30m. Also please follow this file naming convention:
```
redwood_benchpack_<asset>-<size>-<variant>-v1.png
example: redwood_benchpack_tile-1080x1080-primary-v1.png
```

BenchBot (automations): Checklist created: [Design brief received] ✅ [Figma file created] ✅ [Copy added] ⬜ [Final exports uploaded] ⬜. Reminder: tag with /deliverable when uploads are done to notify #marketing.

Tess Rivera: Thanks — will mark copy as needed. @Liam when you drop the copy pack please include short alt text for social images (for accessibility).

Liam O'Connor: On it — alt text included in the copy doc. Dropping the copy now: link -> (social lines + email headers + webinar CTAs).

Maya Chen: Perfect. Small compliance ask: Legal reviewed the stats language earlier; please include the micro-disclaimer text in 8pt at the bottom of the one-pager: "Benchmark figures represent internal tests; customer results may vary."

Tess Rivera: Adding disclaimer, and I'll prepare a brand-guardrail checklist for the export pack.

Maya Chen: Great — thanks team. If any blockers, ping me. Otherwise, first pass tomorrow EOD and we aim to publish assets Thurs morning across channels. :rocket:
